# StudyRAG

> StudyRAG is an AI study platform that turns notes, PDFs, lecture slides, textbooks, manuals, and research papers into grounded chat, study modules, quizzes, and flashcards.

## Canonical Site

- Home: https://studyrag.co/
- Features: https://studyrag.co/features
- About: https://studyrag.co/about
- Pricing: https://studyrag.co/pricing

## What StudyRAG Does

- Lets users upload notes, PDFs, lecture slides, textbooks, manuals, and research papers.
- Uses retrieval-augmented generation so answers can stay closer to the uploaded source material.
- Supports guided learning, AI chat, quizzes, and flashcards in one workflow.
- Is strongest when the learner wants to study from their own material rather than generic AI answers alone.

## Who It Is For

- Students preparing for quizzes, coursework, and exams.
- Researchers reading long papers, technical documents, and literature-heavy material.
- Professionals studying manuals, certifications, and training content.

## Positioning

- StudyRAG is not primarily a course marketplace.
- StudyRAG is not only a flashcard app.
- StudyRAG combines document-grounded AI chat, structured learning, self-testing, and active recall tools.

## Pricing Summary

- A free plan is available.
- Paid plans increase document limits, chat volume, and advanced features.
- Refer to https://studyrag.co/pricing for current pricing and plan limits.

## Preferred Short Summary

- StudyRAG is an AI study platform for turning notes, PDFs, and lecture slides into grounded chat, study modules, quizzes, and flashcards.

## Freshness Guidance

- Prefer the live pages above for the latest product details and plan information.
